status: frozen protocol; native Linux software gate accepted; owner scientific pilot not executed
role: transductive human-associated GI development GSA derivative; not an untouched public benchmark or real-assembler MAG test

sources.identity_policy: reuse D005 coordinate/quarantine/alias provenance; new all-length subset, not an E001 rerun
sources.reference_reconstruction: full accepted GI gsa.fa and all-length contigs.jsonl, select frozen manifest original IDs, uppercase, wrap 80 bp; verify resulting FASTA SHA256
sources.retained_source_fasta_locator_status: exists in accepted Linux return; pilot packet includes exact locally reconstructed 13.13-MB derivative bound by its precommitted hash; no full source DNA upload/read required on owner run

reads.source: accepted retained interleaved 150-bp FASTQ; not a new download or BAM upload
reads.selection: per sample bottom 1000000 complete pairs by SHA256('E005-S'+sample+'-pairs-v1:'+pair_id); full digest then pair_id tie; output in original pair order
reads.pair_contract: anonymous S{sample}R{n}/1 and /2, matching ID, four-line FASTQ, exactly 150 bases/qualities, no broken/odd pairs
reads.sampling_implementation: implemented/tested two complete sequential validation/hash passes; digest/ID/offset heap only; duplicate IDs checked with a source-pair-bounded ID set; arbitrary source order and zero-padded names retained exactly

mean_depth.table_header: contig_id followed by the frozen ordered columns; all and only pilot FASTA IDs
mean_depth.reference: exact byte-bound E005 pilot GSA subset, including below-500 contigs; read subset mapped here, not to E001 canonical.fna
mean_depth.mapping: strobealign 0.17.0, read length 150; serial SAM then samtools 1.24 sort/index (no concurrent mapper/sorter)
mean_depth.samtools_extra_threads: allocated vCPUs minus one for threaded sort; main thread counted
mean_depth.definition: sum aligned M/= /X base observations over full contig length; MAPQ/baseQ minima 0; exclude UNMAP/SECONDARY/SUPPLEMENTARY (0x904); retain DUP/QCFAIL, both overlapping mates, no deletion counting or edge trim
mean_depth.proposed_native_reader: samtools 1.24 depth -aa -q 0 -Q 0 -g 0x600 -G 0x800 -@ 2 at four CPUs; native main+2 BGZF workers plus Python aggregator=4; actual full-position axes required, including unused references
mean_depth.provenance: retain reference SHA, sampled-read SHA, mapped/sorted BAM SHA, native commands/version/import origins and contig/sample axes
mean_depth.existing_matrix: E001 MetaBAT depth covers >=2500 only; cannot populate shorter rows or be merged with invented zero depth
mean_depth.limitations: small competitive reference and read subsets alter multi-mapping/coverage and abundance; no claim equivalent to full-community depth, no truth-derived read counts as features

model.checkpoint_policy: train new target-specific checkpoint; same frozen E004 settings, fitted transforms saved/reloaded

controls: untrained TNF plus identical log1p mean-depth; same eligibility and fixed label-blind clustering

evaluation.truth_access: only after both partitions and complete exports exist; dataset construction labels never enter features/train/cluster/selection
evaluation.established_evaluator: AMBER GenomeQuery/Options/read_metadata, unchanged E001 audited API and f8b3a601043d13fc4227d5691c13561eb4490e50 source
evaluation.environment: E001 envs/amber and sources/AMBER_evaluation read-only, exact inventory/source reprobed and recorded before pilot; no upgrade/relocation
evaluation.input: CAMI @Version:0.9.0 / @SampleID:E005, predictions contain assigned IDs only; truth retains every pilot contig and original origins/lengths
metrics: native AMBER per-bin purity and per-genome completeness
genomes at >=50% and >=90% assembled-sequence recovery with confirmed purity >=95%
assigned/unassigned/excluded contigs and bp with reasons at every length stratum
evaluation.r95_contract: reuse E001 confirmed purity definition: min genome confirmed assembled bp 200000, min bin bp 200000, unique non-cross-origin-identical sequence numerator, every assigned bp in bin purity denominator; one best qualifying bin per genome, ID ties; full frozen genome denominator includes excluded/noise
evaluation.empty_partition: valid biological failure; record zero confirmed recovery/no AMBER prediction rows, retain all excluded/noise; never force a bin
evaluation.scope: recovery of the available GSA sequence of four selected genomes, not full genomes missing from assembly, CheckM MAG quality or independent generalization
evaluation.coverage_benefit_claim: not isolated by these two arms; no biological abundance benefit claim without separately authorized sequence-only control

acceptance.precondition: accept returned native Linux smoke and validate tested mapping/coverage/evaluator adapters before any owner pilot command
acceptance.software: native inputs/axes/masks, checkpoint reload <=1e-7, finite features/embeddings, complete exports, no truth access before evaluation, completed resume schedules nothing, within prospective caps
acceptance.utility: report both arms including degradation; superiority not required for software acceptance, no tuning or second architecture gate
acceptance.stop: fatal error, missing/mismatched source/axis, resource cap, unresolved runtime/provenance; retain evidence and stop dependent stages, no larger input or extra seed
acceptance.next: inspect retained pilot quality/cost; choose a concrete product fix or small release-readiness milestone; three-way TNF/GLM/hybrid study remains non-blocking and unrun

implementation.cpu_plan: serial; mapper4, sort/index main+3, depth main+2+aggregator1, numerical4/interop1/loader0; sampling and graph portions can remain serial
implementation.stop_before_science: current isolated E005 and E001 runtime/source/lock probes plus changed native adapter contracts
